mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 7 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 4.

Two passenger trains collided in the al-Ayyat district of Giza province, about 73 km south of Cairo, causing a serious railway accident in Egypt.

A drone strike hit Iraq's Khor Mor gas field, cutting gas supply and reducing electricity generation by roughly 2.8 gigawatts.

An 81-year-old pedestrian was killed after being struck by a car in a fatal accident in the city of Durrës, Albania.

Albanian opposition parties have agreed to form a joint front and present a single candidate list for every municipality in the upcoming local elections against Prime Minister Edi Rama's government.

Spanish club Tenerife announced it will financially support the daughter of its late player Jesús de Miguel, who died in a traffic accident last week.
